intro.zh: Fail Forward Gallery 是由大学生团队运营的匿名失败故事分享与同伴支持项目。这份说明解释我们在你使用账户、投稿和阅读时处理哪些信息、为什么处理、谁能看到。
intro.en: Fail Forward Gallery is an anonymous failure-story and peer-support project run by a university student team. This notice explains what information is handled when you use an account, write, or read, why, and who can see it.

items.zh: 手机号：只用于发送验证码和确认账户归属。服务器只保存手机号经密钥计算后的指纹，不保存明文手机号。由于手机号的取值范围有限，如果数据库和服务器密钥同时泄露，理论上可以通过穷举还原，因此正式环境中两者分开保管。正式接入短信服务后，发送验证码时手机号会交给短信服务商。
items.en: Mobile number: used only to send a verification code and confirm who owns an account. The server keeps only a keyed fingerprint of the number, never the number itself. Because phone numbers are a limited set, someone holding both the database and the server key could in principle recover numbers by trying them all, so the two are kept separately in production. Once a real SMS service is connected, the number is passed to that provider to send the code.

items.zh: 你写下的内容：故事、回应、后续更新，以及你提交的举报和申诉。
items.en: What you write: stories, responses, follow-ups, and any reports or appeals you submit.

items.zh: 审核与通知记录：每条内容的审核状态、理由和时间，以及发给你的站内通知。
items.en: Review and notice records: each item's review status, reasons, and times, and the in-site notices sent to you.

items.zh: 登录凭证：保持登录的会话 Cookie，以及防止跨站请求伪造的令牌。
items.en: Sign-in credentials: a session cookie that keeps you signed in and a token that protects against cross-site request forgery.

items.zh: 阅读统计：一个随机的访客 Cookie，用来避免同一个人重复计数。它在保存前与当天日期一起加密哈希，无法跨天关联到同一个人；逐条阅读记录 8 天后删除，之后只保留每篇故事的累计数。
items.en: Reading figures: a random visitor cookie so the same person is not counted twice. It is hashed with the date before storage, so one person cannot be linked across days; individual view records are deleted after 8 days, leaving only each story's total.

items.zh: 网络地址：只在服务器内存中短暂用于防止刷量和限制请求频率，不写入数据库。
items.en: Network address: held briefly in server memory to limit abuse and request rates; it is never written to the database.

items.zh: 所有人：只能看到审核通过的匿名内容，看不到手机号、账户，也没有能把不同内容关联到同一个人的标识。
items.en: Everyone: only approved anonymous content, with no mobile number, account, or anything that links different items to the same person.

items.zh: 审核员：看到待审核的内容和必要上下文，看不到作者的手机号或账户身份，也看不到举报人是谁。
items.en: Reviewers: content awaiting review and the context needed to judge it, but not the writer's number or account, nor who reported anything.

items.zh: 管理员：管理审核团队。团队成员以管理员填写的名称显示。
items.en: Administrators: manage the review team, whose members appear under names the administrators give them.

items.zh: 你自己：在“我的账户”中看到自己的内容、审核状态、理由和阅读数据。阅读数字只有你能看到。
items.en: You: your own content, review status, reasons, and reading figures in My account. Only you see those figures.

heading.zh: 我们如何使用这些信息

items.zh: 运行平台、人工审核、发送站内通知、防止滥用，以及生成不包含任何个人身份的故事榜单。我们不出售信息，也不用于广告。
items.en: To run the platform, review content, send in-site notices, prevent abuse, and build story rankings that contain no personal identity. Information is never sold or used for advertising.

items.zh: 如果你写下的内容显示你或他人可能处于紧急危险，审核员可能暂缓公开，并向你提供求助信息。【待团队补充：是否以及在什么情况下联系外部机构。】
items.en: If what you write suggests you or someone else may be in immediate danger, a reviewer may hold it back and offer you support information. [To be completed by the team: whether and when outside services would be contacted.]

items.zh: 你可以随时撤回自己的内容，撤回后会立即从公开页面移除。为了让审核过程可追溯，审核记录会保留。【待团队补充：保留期限。】
items.en: You can withdraw your own content at any time; it leaves public pages immediately. Review records are kept so decisions stay accountable. [To be completed by the team: how long they are kept.]

items.zh: 你可以在“我的账户”中下载一份与你有关的全部数据，也可以删除账户。删除时你可以选择已公开的内容是全部删除，还是保留为不属于任何账户的匿名内容；其余内容、你的申诉和举报说明都会删除。审核决定与理由会保留，但不再关联到任何账户。审核团队成员需先由管理员撤销角色，才能删除账户。
items.en: In My account you can download everything held about you, and delete your account. When deleting, you choose whether your public content is deleted or kept as anonymous content that belongs to no account; everything else, including your appeal and report explanations, is deleted. Review decisions and reasons are kept with no link to any account. Review team members must be removed from the team by an administrator before deleting.

items.zh: 这份说明有实质变化时会更新版本号，并请你重新阅读和同意。
items.en: When this notice changes materially, its version changes and you will be asked to read and agree again.

intro.zh: 这里是一个分享失败、也接住失败的地方。下面的规则帮助每个人安全、放心地说出自己的经历。
intro.en: This is a place to share failure and to be met with care. These rules help everyone tell their story safely.

summary.zh: 这是同伴支持和教育项目，不是心理治疗或紧急救援服务。
summary.en: This is a peer-support and education project, not therapy or an emergency service.

summary.zh: 不要写姓名、电话、邮箱、学号、详细地址，也不要写能认出其他人（老师、同学、单位）的细节。
summary.en: Do not include names, phone numbers, email, student IDs, or addresses, or details that identify anyone else (teachers, classmates, employers).

summary.zh: 所有内容都要经过人工审核才会公开。AI 安全筛查目前尚未接入。
summary.en: Everything is reviewed by a person before it is published. AI safety screening is not connected yet.

summary.zh: 如果内容显示你或他人可能处于紧急危险，它不会直接公开，你会看到求助信息。
summary.en: If what you write suggests you or someone else may be in immediate danger, it will not be published directly, and you will be shown support information.

summary.zh: 你可以选择别人如何回应（包括不接收回应），可以随时撤回自己的内容，被拒绝时可以申诉一次。
summary.en: You choose how others may respond (including not at all), can withdraw your content at any time, and can appeal each rejection once.

items.zh: 真实的失败，以及随之而来的羞耻、失落、焦虑、孤独或愤怒。
items.en: Real failures and the shame, loss, anxiety, loneliness, or anger that come with them.

items.zh: “没有变化”“仍然很难”也是真实有效的结局，不需要硬写成励志故事。
items.en: "Nothing has changed" or "it is still hard" are valid endings; no story has to become inspirational.

items.zh: 在作者选择的回应方式之内、尊重对方的回应。
items.en: Respectful responses within the type of response the author chose.

items.zh: 针对个人或群体的侮辱、贬低、威胁或骚扰。
items.en: Insults, belittling, threats, or harassment aimed at a person or group.

items.zh: 鼓励自伤、暴力或其他危险行为。
items.en: Encouraging self-harm, violence, or other dangerous behaviour.

items.zh: 公开他人的姓名、联系方式、学号、地址或其他能认出对方的信息。
items.en: Revealing anyone's name, contact details, student ID, address, or other identifying information.

items.zh: 广告、诈骗、引流和重复刷屏；冒充原作者发布后续。
items.en: Advertising, scams, redirecting people elsewhere, or repeated posting; posting follow-ups as if you were the original author.

items.zh: 故事、回应和公开的后续都要经过人工审核；审核员会写明理由，你可以在“我的账户”中查看。
items.en: Stories, responses, and public follow-ups are all reviewed by a person, who records a reason you can read in My account.

items.zh: 未通过的内容可以就每个审核决定申诉一次，由审核员复核。
items.en: Each decision not to publish can be appealed once, and a reviewer looks at it again.

items.zh: 你可以举报他人公开的内容；作者不会知道是谁举报的。
items.en: You can report other people's public content; authors never learn who reported.

items.zh: 当内容显示有人可能处于危险中时，审核员可以暂缓公开，并优先跟进。这不是惩罚，而是想先确认你一切安好。
items.en: When content suggests someone may be in danger, reviewers can hold it back and follow up first. This is not a penalty; we want to check that you are okay.
